description: Source file implementing tensor fill operations such as fill, fill_diagonal, and zeroing tensors in the ATen library of PyTorch.

methods.name: fill_out
methods.description: Fills a tensor with a scalar value, optimized for CPU tensors with a single element.

methods.name: fill_out_quantized
methods.description: Fills a tensor with a scalar value in a quantized manner.

methods.name: fill_
methods.description: In-place fill of a tensor with a scalar value.

methods.name: fill_quantized_
methods.description: In-place fill of a tensor with a quantized scalar value.

methods.name: fill_
methods.description: In-place fill of a tensor with another tensor (must be 0-d).

methods.name: fill_quantized_
methods.description: In-place fill of a tensor with a quantized tensor (must be 0-d).

methods.name: fill_meta_
methods.description: Meta operation for fill, does nothing.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Creates a new tensor filled with a scalar or tensor value.

methods.name: fill_diagonal_
methods.description: Fills the diagonal of a tensor, with optional wrapping.

methods.name: zero_
methods.description: Zeros out a tensor efficiently if on CPU and dense.

methods.name: zero_meta_
methods.description: Meta operation for zero, does nothing.
